issues.desc: background.md ## Conversational Texture, in the newly-appended sentence naming the four cross-host audits, introduces "Agy" ("Codex + Agy auditing the technical design") without expanding or defining it anywhere in background.md/index.json/checklist.json. A fresh reader can guess from context that Agy is another automated reviewer/tool paired with Codex, but the term itself (short for an Antigravity-CLI-style host) is never spelled out in this story artifact. Minor readability gap only; does not block understanding of the substantive technical content (evidence-add contradiction check + refresh_stale honesty).
